answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the onyx of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Each submission hangs on the grove of a task receipt, and the ember is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, converted to a slow vesting stream, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
